title: Assess ordinary source capture refusal of merged case-variant tracked directories
outcome: The ordinary no-gitlink source-capture boundary has an explicitly decided policy and evidence for a clean checkout whose case-variant tracked ancestor directories merge on an insensitive filesystem.
acceptance: A disposable ordinary repository reproduces the merged-ancestor case layout with distinct tracked regular-file identities and records the current admission result.
Any proposed widening of ordinary admission is explicitly decided and documented independently of the child-only change, with ordinary byte encoding preserved and true collisions/redirects refused.
The agreed behavior has meaningful counterexamples and restored positives on applicable platforms.
